What to build

Anything a community runs on.

WallFlowers is a social network made of groups: every space is private to the people in it, and everything written there is theirs. Build on the Community API and make something a group of people would actually use together.

Sites & publications

A page anyone can visit, with a room behind it only the people in it can read.

Events & forums

What’s happening, who’s coming, and the threads a group keeps together.

Messages & marketplaces

Conversations sealed to the people in them, and what you’re offering among the people you trust.

How it works

Three steps to the podium.

  1. Register for the hackathon on Luma.
  2. Build a project using the WallFlowers Community API — solo or as a team. Start with the quickstart; AI coding agents, read agents.md.
  3. Demo it. The top three take ₩100,000, ₩50,000 and ₩25,000.
